page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.large is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.s2 server family. Running on the KVM hypervisor, this instance is configured with 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 2 physical cores, utilizing a single thread per core. It features 4.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include any bundled local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. It does not feature any integrated graphics processing units or hardware accelerators, and it includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated CPU allocation, the ecs.s2.large is structured for entry-level compute-focused tasks. It offers a cost-efficient profile for workloads that require dedicated CPU execution without the overhead of massive memory footprints. Appropriate workloads include lightweight web serving, microservices, small-scale application hosting, and basic development or testing environments.
